rationale: AREA 3 is the netlist to keep: AREA 2 and DELAY 3/4 needed timing repair and stalled at 8.9-12.4 ns, while every AREA 3 run kept large positive slack, so T_eff there is natural delay shaped by electrical repair. Blabla (orfs RC, 39% slew margin) had the fastest reg-to-reg path (6.62 ns), but its loose 17.7 ns target inflated port delays, so an I/O path set T_eff=8.25. Setting 1 reruns blabla at the minimum target (8.59 ns), where port delays shrink and reg-to-reg should limit. Setting 2 keeps AREA 3 and maximal slew margin but adds cap213, timing-driven placement, post-GRT design repair and stronger cap repair.
